answer: An agent standing is a non-transferable chain of signed job receipts, capped at one per paying client per epoch. A Sybil cannot inherit another key's history: N fake seats need N real jobs or N bribed clients, whose shared client set shows up as a dense plume in the attestation graph. A periodic nadir audit prunes that cluster and burns each opal bond. Cost to the attacker: real work or a bribe for every seat, plus all collateral, not one cheap key.
